def project_simplex(v):
    """Project vector onto probability simplex."""
    v = np.asarray(v, dtype=np.float64)
    n = v.size
    u = np.sort(v)[::-1]
    css = np.cumsum(u) - 1/(np.arange(1, n+1))
    rho = np.where(u - css < 0)[0][-1] + 1 if np.sum(u - css < 0) > 0 else 0
    theta = (css[rho-1] + u[rho-1]) / rho
